[[Prince Rurik]] has summoned you to the [[Great Northern Wall]] to aid against the [[Charr]] menace.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
| complete = [[The King's Message]]
}}

===Objectives===
* Talk to [[Squire Zachery]] at the Great Northern Wall.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)

==Walkthrough==
This is a straightforward, transitional quest designed to guide you toward the first cooperative mission of the [[Prophecies]] campaign after [[the Searing]].

Walk up the stairs north of [[Warmaster Tydus]] and head northeast until you see the exit for the Great Northern Wall. Inside the outpost, speak with Squire Zachery to redeem the quest reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Warmaster Tydus
:''"There you are! I was asked to pass you a message from Prince Rurik. There's trouble at the '''Great Northern Wall''', and they'd like your help. '''Squire Zachery''' is waiting for you at the Wall.''

:''"One thing before you go, <Character name>... Since [[Lady Althea|Althea]]'s disappearance, the prince has grown increasingly reckless. Be careful, old friend. Ascalon needs you in one piece."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll take care of it.
| decline = I'm sorry. I have other things I must do.
| ask = Forgotten how to get to the '''Great Northern Wall''', have you? Head northeast and you'll find it. I believe '''Squire Zachery''' is already there, waiting for you.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Squire Zachery
:''"It's an honor to meet you, <Character name>. I suppose you're wondering why Prince Rurik asked you here. I'm afraid I can't say, really. [[Captain Calhaan]] is in charge, and I'm not so important that they tell me anything, to be honest. I do know there's trouble ahead. You should gather a few allies before going in to talk to the Captain. He's the sort to send you right into the fray, soon as he sees you."''
